purpose: Tres propuestas dirigidas con Impeccable a partir de la referencia del usuario, con logo y texto del hero a la derecha.

variants.title: W · Transición amplia
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / layout edit. Create ONE refined 1600x1000 desktop hero proposal based on reference 1, the user's chosen visual direction. Keep its white NAV header with the logo at FAR LEFT, green/white identity, institutional typography, and exact existing copy. Move ALL HERO branding, headline, body and primary button to the RIGHT side. The navbar logo must remain at left, clearly separated spatially from the right-hand hero logo.
Reference 2 is the complete official JSDP-Sonora-11 logo: use this exact intact image for both logo placements. Preserve the IMSS emblem/letters, gray divider, green JSDP, dark spaced Sonora, and green/gold/gray underline. No substitute wordmark.
Reference 3 is the actual hospital photograph. Show it prominently on the LEFT, preserving its orientation, building, palms and entrance. Do NOT mirror the photo or the whole screen.
CRITICAL: the clear reading background on the RIGHT must extend continuously through the FULL HERO HEIGHT, touching the header's bottom and the canvas's bottom. Any fade is HORIZONTAL ONLY and identical from top to bottom. It must read as a full-height luminous side zone, NOT a floating white cloud, oval, radial spotlight, detached card, rounded box or isolated patch. The photograph still occupies the majority, approximately 60–65 percent of the width.
Hero copy verbatim: "Jefatura de Servicios de Desarrollo de Personal"; "Órgano de Operación Administrativa Desconcentrada Sonora del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social."; green button "Conoce la JSDP".
Remove the old reference's entire bottom navigation rail and carousel controls. The background rotates automatically in the eventual implementation. Show ONLY an informational dark-green label with WHITE "Unidades médicas" at the LOWER LEFT over the photo. No carousel arrows, play/pause, dots, pagination, progress bars or other categories. Preserve normal NAV links and action button. No proposal titles in the image.
VARIANT W: spacious RIGHT reading zone, approximately 40% wide. A broad, beautifully smooth linear horizontal transition blends the hospital into continuous white on the right, with precisely the same profile at every vertical position. The exact hero logo, generous three-line serif headline, body and button are left-aligned within that right zone and balanced vertically as one group. Comfortable right margin. The left photograph stays fully colored and sharply visible. This is the closest refinement of the supplied concept, with the direction of reading reversed.
